content.text: The full test suite passes and the branch remains clean. The parallel audits converged on a small set of concrete blockers: the named install cannot yet work from current releases/index metadata, `init-agents` has under-disclosed overwrite/import behavior, and two cache/tree claims need tighter semantics. I’m consolidating those into the final review now.

Committed all changes as `d17975a` (`docs: refresh README and reorganize documentation`). The worktree is clean, and `mise run test` passes.

Review findings for [docs/readme-plan.md](/Users/thomi/Projects/entire-graph/docs/readme-plan.md:1):

- **Blocker — indexed installation is not currently publishable.** The official [plugin index](https://github.com/entireio/plugin-index/blob/main/index.json) lacks `graph`, the current [v0.2.0 release](https://github.com/entireio/entire-graph/releases/tag/v0.2.0) has no installable plugin archives, and [release.sh](/Users/thomi/Projects/entire-graph/scripts/release.sh:27) produces filenames/checksums incompatible with the CLI’s [plugin asset discovery](https://github.com/entireio/cli/blob/v0.10.0/cmd/entire/cli/plugin_fetch.go#L183-L223). Replace the assumption at [plan:23](/Users/thomi/Projects/entire-graph/docs/readme-plan.md:23) with an owned, publication-blocking release/index prerequisite.

- **High — `--head` can mix committed graph data with live working-tree source.** `neighbors` and `impact` load a HEAD snapshot, then annotate results from disk ([neighbors.go](/Users/thomi/Projects/entire-graph/internal/cli/neighbors.go:153), [impact.go](/Users/thomi/Projects/entire-graph/internal/cli/impact.go:140)); `def` has similar live-body behavior, and `explain --head` still prints “from the working tree” ([explain.go](/Users/thomi/Projects/entire-graph/internal/cli/explain.go:332)). This needs an explicit product prerequisite before documenting exact tree semantics.

- **High — the no-duplicate-import acceptance criterion is presently unattainable.** `init-agents` always writes pointers to both files, while this repository’s [CLAUDE.md](/Users/thomi/Projects/entire-graph/CLAUDE.md:1) imports `AGENTS.md` and the guide directly; [AGENTS.md](/Users/thomi/Projects/entire-graph/AGENTS.md:201) imports it again. The plan acknowledges this at [line 148](/Users/thomi/Projects/entire-graph/docs/readme-plan.md:148) but requires no duplicate import at [line 411](/Users/thomi/Projects/entire-graph/docs/readme-plan.md:411). Define a supported manual layout, relax the criterion, or make import-aware behavior a product prerequisite.

- **Medium — activation side effects are under-disclosed.** `.entire/graph-agent.md` is overwritten wholesale on every run ([agents.go](/Users/thomi/Projects/entire-graph/internal/cli/agents.go:98)); marker idempotence only holds for one intact block. The README plan should disclose overwrite behavior and document malformed/duplicate-marker recovery.

- **Medium — “any dirty graph-relevant path disables reuse” is inaccurate.** Dirty indexable files and resolver manifests bypass caching ([search_cache.go](/Users/thomi/Projects/entire-graph/internal/sem/search_cache.go:145)), but `.graphignore` changes instead select a content-keyed cache entry ([search_cache.go](/Users/thomi/Projects/entire-graph/internal/sem/search_cache.go:831)). Tighten the wording at [plan:203](/Users/thomi/Projects/entire-graph/docs/readme-plan.md:203).

- **Medium — `index` prewarming is profile/options-specific.** `index` defaults to `full` ([index.go](/Users/thomi/Projects/entire-graph/internal/cli/index.go:181)), while `search` defaults to `fast` ([search.go](/Users/thomi/Projects/entire-graph/internal/cli/search.go:1718). Therefore a default `index` run does not warm a bare `search --head`; the plan should specify matching profile and graph-shaping options.

- **Medium — cache ADR supersession needs explicit mechanics.** ADR 0002 remains accepted and says working-tree mode is uncached ([ADR 0002](/Users/thomi/Projects/entire-graph/docs/adr/0002-committed-tree-cache-key.md:134)), while the docs index still names it authoritative. The plan should name the replacement ADR, mark ADR 0002 superseded with a forward link, and update [docs/README.md](/Users/thomi/Projects/entire-graph/docs/README.md:33).
